blocks.text: Inhein “flatworms” (chapte keere) kehte hain. In ka jism unsegmented, naram aur dorsoventrally compressed hota hai, yani upar se neeche chapta. Zyada tar free-living (aazad) hain, jaise planaria. Kuch insaanon aur doosre janwaron ke andar rehne wale parasites (endoparasites) hain, jaise liver fluke, tapeworm aur blood fluke.

Flatworms triploblastic hain, yani jism ke tissues embryo ki teen layers, ectoderm, mesoderm aur endoderm, se bante hain. Yeh acoelomates hain: body wall aur organs ke darmiyan ki jagah ek dheela connective tissue, parenchyma, bharta hai. In mein bilateral symmetry hai, yani waazeh baayan aur daayan hissa, aur dorsal (peeth) aur ventral (pait) ki taraf. In mein respiratory aur circulatory (transport) systems nahi hote. In mein nali jaisi protonephridia ka jaal hota hai jis ki bohat si shaakhein hain. Har shaakh ke sire par ek bulb jaisa cell hota hai jise flame cell kehte hain. Flame cells ke cilia hil kar aas paas ka fluid naliyon mein kheenchte hain. Naliyan fluid se fuzla chhaan kar body wall ke ek chhote soorakh, nephridiopore, se bahar nikal deti hain. In mein neurons ka jaal hota hai. Aage ke sire (head) mein cerebral ganglia hote hain, jo lambai mein chalne wali nerve cords se jure hote hain; yeh cords aar paar shaakhon (transverse branches) se aapas mein mili hoti hain. Zyada tar aazad flatworms ke aage do saada eyespots hote hain. Flatworms “fission” se asexual reproduction karte hain: janwar beech se sikur kar do tukron mein bat jata hai aur har tukra apna ghaib hissa dobara bana leta hai. Sexual reproduction karne wale flatworms hermaphrodites (bisexual) hain, yani ek hi janwar mein nar aur maada dono organs hote hain.
